'''Mesan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who maintained a shop on the [[Promenade]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Mesan sold [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] in addition to other weaponry.<ref name="Promenade" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mesan was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]].<ref name="Global Launch">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20111014-1|text=Global Launch for The Old Republic}}</ref> He appears on Nar Shaddaa as a weapons vendor.<ref name="Promenade" />
